auth.note: The server is documented as unauthenticated and listens on localhost by default. Binding it to all interfaces exposes it to the network.

verified.notes: Port 1234 and the OpenAI-style API are from LM Studio's server docs. The lms subcommands are listed by a community index of its CLI. Confirm each command with `lms --help` and the extra model fields from the native REST API before relying on them.
